# Technology logo sources

Downloaded 2026-10-16 and served locally. These are third-party trademarks, displayed to identify the tools used by Pedro Victor.

- Python, Java, TypeScript, Dart, FastAPI, Flutter, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS, Docker, Git: https://github.com/devicons/devicon (original variants; AWS original wordmark). See devicon-LICENSE.txt.
- Hugging Face (Transformers) and n8n: https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos (hugging-face-icon.svg and n8n-icon.svg). See logos-LICENSE.txt.
- Power BI: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerBI-Icons/blob/main/SVG/Power-BI.svg

The Hugging Face logo represents the Transformers library. Names remain visible alongside all logos.
